name: Academic CV Codespace
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates && curl -L https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v0.162.0/hugo_extended_0.162.0_linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/hugo.tar.gz && sudo tar -xzf /tmp/hugo.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin hugo && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.14.0 --activate
postCreateCommand: hugo version && pnpm --version && node --version && go version
